title: Infinity '26 — Annual Cultural Fest
excerpt: Three days. Twelve venues. Unstructured infinity — the council's biggest production of the year.
description: Infinity '26 was the council's flagship cultural fest — three days, twelve venues, headline acts on the main stage and underground sets running till 2 AM. We pulled 8K+ footfall across the weekend, with 40+ student clubs running their own sub-events under the umbrella.

title: Utopia · Esports Cup
excerpt: FC25, MK, and the gaming community in one room — the post-game glow, on tape.
description: Utopia's first esports cup of the year. FC25 and Mortal Kombat tournaments ran across two days, with the community turning up in force. The vibes after the final match — that's what this video captured.

title: Kathakriti — Literature Festival
excerpt: From game stalls to verbal-olympics-level debates — the kind of energy you want every literature event to have.
description: Kathakriti opened with a debate that turned into a verbal olympics, and the energy never dropped. Slam poetry, book swaps, panel talks with visiting authors, and a closing night open mic that ran 90 minutes over schedule.

title: Halloween '25 — Jashn
excerpt: When the lights dimmed and the spooky took over — costumes, chills, and pure chaos under the campus sky.
description: The Council turned the amphitheatre into a haunted house for one night. Costume contest, themed photobooth, three DJs across the night and a midnight horror screening on the lawn projector.

title: Woxsen Immersion Bootcamp
excerpt: Five days of design thinking, founder talks and immersive workshops that kick off the academic year.
description: The Immersion Bootcamp is the Council's flagship onboarding programme — a five-day intensive that blends design thinking studios, founder fireside chats, peer-led workshops and campus exploration. Open to all incoming and continuing students.

title: Woxathon 2026 — 48hr Hackathon
excerpt: 48 hours. Open theme. Real prizes. Build something that matters with mentors from across industry.
description: Woxathon is Woxsen's flagship hackathon — open theme, 48 hours, hardware and software tracks. Mentors from leading tech companies, ₹2L+ in prizes, and a chance to ship a prototype investors actually look at.

title: Rhythms — Cultural Night
excerpt: An evening of music, dance and student-led performances under the open sky.
description: Rhythms is the Council's signature cultural night — student bands, classical performances, dance battles and a headline act. Pull up with your hostel block, claim your spot.

title: Founders Circle — Q3 Edition
excerpt: An intimate fireside with three Woxsen alumni who've raised seed rounds in the last year.
description: Three Woxsen alumni founders, one room, off-the-record stories about raising, hiring, breaking, and shipping. Limited to 60 seats — first come, first served.

title: Inter-College Football Cup
excerpt: Eight colleges. Four days. One trophy. Come for the football, stay for the chaos.
description: The Inter-College Football Cup brings teams from eight regional universities to Woxsen for four days of group-stage football. Free entry, food trucks on the sidelines.

title: Global Week
excerpt: Visiting faculty, international student panels, food fairs — a week that brings the world to Woxsen.
description: Global Week is a campus-wide celebration of Woxsen's international partnerships — visiting professors run masterclasses, international students host their countries' food stalls, and the week closes with a panel on studying abroad.

title: 24hr Design Jam
excerpt: Pick a brief at midnight. Ship a prototype by midnight tomorrow.
description: Cross-discipline design jam. Briefs are released at 00:00, teams form on the spot, and prototypes are presented to a panel of working designers 24 hours later.

title: Open Mic Night
excerpt: Bring a song, a poem, a stand-up set, or just a chair. Low stakes, full vibes.
description: The Council's monthly open mic — sign up at the door, get five minutes, walk away with applause (or a polite cough). Run by students, for students.
